[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
William was born in 1848. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2175|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Finley-4018|Mary Finley]]. He passed away in 1919.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2175]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The retained 1887 Robert sketch names William F at Fort Madison among his children. This matches William Finley's 1848 birth and later Fort Madison records, specifically identifying Robert rather than relying on surname alone.

Selected Glasgow-2175 fatherhood of Glasgow-2177; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare original 1885 marriage with the 1887 family sketch.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2175 Portrait and Biographical Album of Washington County, Iowa: (United States, Brookhaven Press, 1887.p 189]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
